# Feature: Customer Statistik (Übersicht)

<!-- auto-generated by /implement on 2026-11-02 — do not edit manually unless correcting intent -->

## Intent
Replace the Übersicht „Kurzprofil“ card with a **Statistik** summary (LTV, customer-since/duration, products, buyer persona). Header button opens a **detail modal**. Backend stores purchases + persona link; LTV is derived as sum of purchase amounts. Roadmap: ad-hoc (chat) — CRM overview value snapshot.

## Preconditions
- Authenticated tenant member; customer detail open on Übersicht
- Editor+ (`canMutateContent`) for writes (persona assign, add/delete purchases)
- Postgres migrated (`buyer_persona_id`, `customer_purchases`)

## Happy Path
- [ ] Übersicht shows Statistik card (not Kurzprofil) with LTV, seit/Dauer, Produkte (kurz), Buyer Persona
- [ ] Empty purchases/persona show clear empty/„—“ states (no fake KPIs)
- [ ] Top-right button opens modal with full purchase list + persona + LTV/Dauer
- [ ] Editor can set persona and add a purchase; LTV updates after refresh
- [ ] Viewer sees read-only summary + modal without mutate controls

## Edge Cases
- [ ] Cross-tenant customer/persona/product IDs → 404/forbidden
- [ ] Invalid purchase amount / missing label → 400
- [ ] Delete purchase recalculates LTV; modal list updates
- [ ] `prefers-reduced-motion` / keyboard: modal Esc + focusable actions

## Regression
- [ ] Customer header identity + Profil tab (birthDate etc.) still work
- [ ] Notes / Vorgänge / Integrationen cards unchanged in overview grid
- [ ] Notes date picker / note create modal still function

## Assumptions
- No full order/billing system yet — `customer_purchases` is the SoR for LTV/products
- `customerSince` defaults to `customers.createdAt` (optional override later)
- Currency EUR for MVP (product currency may vary; display EUR aggregate)
- Kurzprofil fields remain available via header + Profil tab only

## Implementation Notes
- Backend: `customer_purchases` + `customers.buyer_persona_id`; `loadCustomerStats` on customer GET; routes GET/PATCH `/stats`, POST/DELETE `/purchases` (tenant + canMutateContent).
- Shared Zod: `CustomerStatsPatchSchema`, `CustomerPurchaseSchema` (label or productId).
- UI: Übersicht Kurzprofil → Statistik card; portal modal for persona + purchase CRUD (editors only); viewers read-only.
- Migration: `apps/api/drizzle/0007_customer_stats.sql` (+ bootstrap). `pnpm run checks` PASS after migrate.
